notes.title: Tokyo Game Dungeon 5
notes.content:
Hello.
We are pleased to announce that the first opportunity to unveil "Kitty Cat Combat" will be at the indie-game exhibition event "Tokyo Game Dungeon 5" to be held on May 4, 2024 at the Tokyo Metropolitan Industrial Trade Center Hamamatsucho Kan! On that day, you will be able to enjoy a map dedicated to the demo version of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785537/3a0a227d52f0611e0d96787171bd79bf74c7958b.png[/img]

Those who try out the game will receive a Musette-san clear file and a flyer. (The illustration above is used for the clear file.) It will take us some time to complete the game in 2025, but we hope to release more information starting with this event. If you live in the Tokyo area, please come and visit us!

For more information about Tokyo Game Dungeon, please visit the [url=https://tokyogamedungeon.com/]official website[/url].
